plan.json: what to deploy for the requested traffic, one tier per capacity model, each value a node of the derivation graph, with the checks the overrides caused.

Schema file: `schema/json/plan.schema.json`. Generated from servtuner commit `ea52778da279`.

## Top level

| Field              | Type                                                     | Required | Description |
| ------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `analyzer_version` | `string`                                                 | Yes      |             |
| `tiers`            | array of [planTier](/reference/schemas/plan/#plantier)   | Yes      |             |
| `derivation`       | `object`                                                 | Yes      |             |
| `checks`           | array of [planCheck](/reference/schemas/plan/#plancheck) | Yes      |             |

## Definitions

### planCheck

A consequence check of the plan: ok, a warning, a value that contradicts the measurements, or a guard rail that blocks the plan.

| Field    | Type                                                    | Required | Description |
| -------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `status` | `"ok"`, `"warning"`, `"violates_measured"`, `"blocked"` | Yes      |             |
| `tier`   | `string`                                                | No       |             |
| `text`   | `string`                                                | Yes      |             |

### planTier

| Field                 | Type                                                                  | Required | Description                                                                                                              |
| --------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `key`                 | `string`                                                              | Yes      | The tier's prefix in the derivation node ids. pattern `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$`                                          |
| `run_id`              | `string`                                                              | Yes      |                                                                                                                          |
| `target_type`         | [targetType](/reference/runspec/#targettype)                          | Yes      |                                                                                                                          |
| `is_blocked`          | `boolean`                                                             | Yes      | A guard rail stops this tier; blocked\_reason says which and what run would unblock it.                                  |
| `blocked_reason`      | `string`                                                              | No       |                                                                                                                          |
| `rps_per_replica`     | `number`                                                              | No       | The SLO-max per replica at the requested SLO. &gt; 0                                                                     |
| `is_interpolated`     | `boolean`                                                             | No       |                                                                                                                          |
| `limiting_slo`        | `string`                                                              | No       |                                                                                                                          |
| `replicas_peak`       | `integer`                                                             | No       | ≥ 1                                                                                                                      |
| `replicas_baseline`   | `integer`                                                             | No       | ≥ 1                                                                                                                      |
| `hpa`                 | `object`                                                              | No       |                                                                                                                          |
| `per_replica`         | [modelPerReplica](/reference/schemas/capacity-model/#modelperreplica) | No       |                                                                                                                          |
| `totals`              | `object`                                                              | No       |                                                                                                                          |
| `utilization_at_peak` | `number`                                                              | No       | Planned per-replica load over the per-replica SLO-max: the real headroom. ≥ 0                                            |
| `sensitivity`         | array of `object`                                                     | No       | Replicas at +25%, +50% and +100% traffic.                                                                                |
| `queue`               | `object`                                                              | No       | Concurrency per replica at the planned load, from the model's W (Poisson-based: there is no measured L(t) at this load). |
| `memory`              | [planTierMemory](/reference/schemas/plan/#plantiermemory)             | No       |                                                                                                                          |
| `scope`               | array of `string`                                                     | Yes      | Labels every number of the tier carries: hardware, workload, arrival process, scale-out.                                 |
| `confidence`          | `"high"`, `"medium"`, `"low"`                                         | Yes      |                                                                                                                          |
| `warnings`            | array of `string`                                                     | No       | Default: `[]`.                                                                                                           |

### planTierMemory

Bytes per in-flight request at the planned request size, m(s) = m\_0 + k × s, and the working set it implies at the planned C plus the run's B.

| Field                     | Type                                                    | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `payload_bytes`           | `number`                                                | No       | The request size planned for; absent when the run reported no request sizes. &gt; 0                                                                                                                |
| `basis`                   | `"measured"`, `"fitted"`, `"extrapolated"`, `"assumed"` | Yes      | measured: the size the run used. fitted: within the sizes of a payload series. extrapolated: outside them. assumed: one measured size, so k is the 1× to 3× assumption and the values are a range. |
| `bytes_per_in_flight`     | `number`                                                | Yes      | m at the planned size; the upper end (k = 3×) when assumed. ≥ 0                                                                                                                                    |
| `bytes_per_in_flight_low` | `number`                                                | No       | The lower end (k = 1×), only when assumed. ≥ 0                                                                                                                                                     |
| `working_set_bytes`       | `number`                                                | Yes      | WS\_0 + m × (C + B) with the limit headroom; the upper end when assumed. ≥ 0                                                                                                                       |
| `working_set_bytes_low`   | `number`                                                | No       | ≥ 0                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `runs`                    | array of `string`                                       | No       | Runs the line m(s) came from.                                                                                                                                                                      |
